question: What is the primary purpose of intersectoral collaboration in healthcare?

options.A: Pooling resources to address complex health challenges
options.D: Centralizing all hospital funding under the federal government

explanation: Intersectoral collaboration brings together different institutional actors to combine strengths and tackle widespread health issues effectively. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h1)

question: Why must nursing students understand the various healthcare sectors?

options.A: To navigate referral pathways and understand system-wide care distribution
options.B: To exclusively secure employment in the private sector
options.C: To manage hospital financial accounting and taxation
options.D: To draft national legislative bills for health budgets

explanation: Knowing how different sectors operate helps clinicians coordinate care and guide patients through diverse healthcare settings. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h1)

question: Which level of government in Nigeria is primarily responsible for managing primary health care clinics?
explanation: Primary health care services and grassroots health posts are managed at the local government level. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h2)

question: What is the primary operational focus of the public health sector?

options.A: Providing specialized elective surgeries for elite clientele
options.B: Maximizing profit margins for institutional shareholders
options.C: Operating strictly on voluntary charitable donations
options.D: Population health, disease prevention, and equitable access

explanation: Public sector institutions prioritize broad public welfare, preventive medicine, and services accessible to the general population. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h2)

question: What is the primary financial driver of the private for-profit healthcare sector?
explanation: Private for-profit facilities rely on patient fees, commercial investments, and private health insurance to sustain operations. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h3)

question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic feature of the private for-profit health sector? (Hint: look for the exception)

options.A: Guaranteed free universal care for all citizens funded by taxes
options.B: Financial sustainability driven by market demand
options.D: Prompt service delivery and modern diagnostic amenities

explanation: Free universal tax-funded care is a characteristic of the public sector, not the for-profit private sector. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h3)

question: What drives the operational model of faith-based and non-profit health organizations?
explanation: Non-profit and faith-based groups operate primarily to serve communities based on social mission rather than financial returns. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h4)

question: Where are faith-based health institutions particularly impactful within developing healthcare landscapes?

options.A: Only within private tertiary research universities
options.B: In rural and remote areas with limited government infrastructure
options.C: Exclusively within high-end metropolitan corporate districts

explanation: Mission and faith-based hospitals historically establish themselves in underserved rural regions to provide essential care where the state cannot. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h4)

question: What is a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) in healthcare?

options.A: A collaborative arrangement combining government oversight with private sector capital and efficiency
options.B: The complete privatization and sale of all public hospitals to foreign investors
options.C: An agreement between two rival private hospitals to share medical equipment
options.D: A union formed exclusively by nurses and doctors to negotiate salaries

explanation: PPPs bridge public and private sectors to leverage private resources while maintaining public health objectives. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h5)

question: A state government wants to upgrade diagnostic services in all public general hospitals without waiting through slow bureaucratic procurement processes. Which approach represents the best application of a healthcare sector collaboration strategy?

options.A: Establish a Public-Private Partnership with a specialized medical technology firm
options.B: Close all public hospitals and direct every patient to traditional healers
options.C: Ban private diagnostic laboratories from operating within the state
options.D: Rely entirely on international volunteer donations for equipment

explanation: A PPP allows private capital and operational efficiency to upgrade public health facilities rapidly under agreed frameworks. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h5)

question: What economic benefit is commonly achieved through coordinated supply chains in intersectoral collaboration?

options.A: Guaranteed infinite budgets for every health clinic
options.B: Elimination of all taxation on medical equipment
options.C: Immediate removal of inflation from the national economy
options.D: Economies of scale that lower medication and supply costs

explanation: Coordinating procurement across sectors allows bulk purchasing and reduces the unit costs of medical goods. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h6)

question: How does cross-sector collaboration affect patient financial burden?

options.A: It helps reduce financial toxicity and smooths care transitions
options.B: It forces all patients to pay double for standard medications
options.C: It restricts patients from ever visiting private pharmacies
options.D: It permanently eliminates all out-of-pocket expenses globally

explanation: Collaboration streamlines care pathways and optimizes funding models, reducing the financial shock of healthcare expenditures on patients. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h6)

question: Which factor is a common cultural barrier in healthcare sector collaboration?

options.A: Clashing values between profit-driven motives and social welfare goals
options.B: Complete absence of any administrative bureaucracy
options.C: Universal agreement on all clinical protocols across sectors
options.D: Identical funding structures in public and private institutions

explanation: Commercial imperatives often conflict with the humanitarian goals of public and non-profit health organizations. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h7)

question: Why do fragmented health information systems hinder collaboration between public and private sectors?

options.A: They eliminate the need for patient consent forms
options.B: They automatically increase government tax revenues
options.C: They force all nurses to work exclusively in administrative offices
options.D: They prevent seamless patient data sharing and continuity of care

explanation: Without interoperable records, patient history remains trapped within siloed facility databases, hindering coordinated treatment. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h7)

question: Why is knowledge of health economics and collaboration sectors important for modern nursing practice in Nigeria?

options.A: It empowers nurses to guide patients through complex payment systems and advocate for efficient care
options.B: It restricts nurses from working outside government-owned tertiary facilities
options.C: It allows nurses to take over hospital financial auditing and tax collection
options.D: It eliminates the need for clinical bedside nursing assessments

explanation: Understanding how different sectors and financing mechanisms operate helps nurses navigate care delivery and advocate for resource access. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h8)

question: What scheme represents a major mechanism for health financing integration in Nigeria that nurses must understand?
explanation: The NHIA coordinates health insurance integration across public and private provider networks in Nigeria. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h8)
